name: H_REMOVED_FRACTION
definition: Material removed (positive) or added (negative) since the landscape's temporal target, as a fraction of the landscape's reconstructed relief
normalization: R_L = P98 - P02 of the scenario-median reference surface inside the support mask
meaning: How much of the constructional landscape has been stripped at this location
inputs: reference-surface ensemble; modern DEM (same as M)
availability: inside support mask; family semantics flag recorded (MINIMUM_REMOVAL for envelope families)
physical_constraints: negative means reference below modern by more than zero; gate uses < -tau_L and values are never clipped
reconstruction_assumptions: conservative constructional surface; envelope variants are minimum-removal estimates
missing_value_handling: NaN outside verified support or for unverified landscape; never zero-filled or imputed
modern_morphology_relationship: shares modern DEM but estimates reference-minus-modern change

name: H_SLOPE_CHANGE_DEG
definition: Present slope minus the slope of the reconstructed surface at the same place
normalization: angles are scale-free; no further normalisation
meaning: Over-steepening by incision relative to the original flank
physical_constraints: finite angles; reconstructed constructional maximum independently gated at 40 degrees
reconstruction_assumptions: 90 m slope calculation and scenario member summary
missing_value_handling: NaN outside verified support or for unverified landscape; never zero-filled or imputed
modern_morphology_relationship: explicitly includes modern slope and is expected partly redundant

name: H_RELIEF_CHANGE_FRACTION
definition: Local dissection: increase of 450 m-window relief over the reconstructed surface, as a fraction of landscape relief
meaning: How strongly the original surface has been dissected around the unit
physical_constraints: finite local-relief difference scaled by positive R_L
reconstruction_assumptions: 450 m relief window and reconstructed ensemble
missing_value_handling: NaN outside verified support or for unverified landscape; never zero-filled or imputed
modern_morphology_relationship: explicitly includes modern relief and is expected partly redundant

name: H_REFERENCE_RELATIVE_HEIGHT
definition: Normalised position on the reconstructed surface (0 = its base, 1 = its top)
normalization: P02_L and R_L of the scenario-median surface
meaning: Palaeogeomorphic position (summit-flank-toe) independent of volcano size
expected_range: nominal 0 to 1; modest extrapolation outside possible
physical_constraints: finite; 0 and 1 are landscape P02/P98 reference anchors, not clipping limits
reconstruction_assumptions: depends on reconstructed P02 and P98
missing_value_handling: NaN outside verified support or for unverified landscape; never zero-filled or imputed
modern_morphology_relationship: reference-surface position can correlate with elevation

name: H_SCENARIO_SPREAD_FRACTION
definition: Disagreement among plausible reconstruction scenarios, as a fraction of landscape relief
meaning: How weakly the earlier surface is constrained here (scenario spread, not a probability)
physical_constraints: nonnegative IQR scaled by positive R_L
reconstruction_assumptions: scenario library spans preregistered structural/parameter alternatives
missing_value_handling: NaN outside verified support or for unverified landscape; never zero-filled or imputed
modern_morphology_relationship: reconstruction-ensemble disagreement rather than modern morphology

name: H_CONTROL_DISTANCE_FRACTION
definition: Distance to the nearest admissible reconstruction control, in units of the landscape size scale
physical_constraints: nonnegative distance; SELECTED_H row rule was <=0.5
reconstruction_assumptions: depends on admissible Y-blind control placement and support scale
missing_value_handling: NaN outside verified support or for unverified landscape; never zero-filled or imputed
modern_morphology_relationship: distance to Y-blind controls rather than morphology
